name: cee-visual
description: Visual regression baseline for the CEDAR Embeddable Editor web component

scripts.fixtures: node generate-fixtures.mjs && rm -rf public/fixtures public/served && cp -r fixtures public/fixtures && cp -r fixtures/served public/served
scripts.prepare:all: npm run bundle && npm run fixtures
scripts.test: npm run test:packaging && node check-bundle-fresh.mjs && npm run check:size && playwright test
scripts.flake-hunt: node check-bundle-fresh.mjs && for i in $(seq 1 ${RUNS:-20}); do echo "--- run $i"; playwright test --retries=0 --reporter=line || exit 1; done
